none: PAS ESS-5945F8: A fragment of a Roman enamelled copper alloy vessel, dating to the 2nd century AD
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of a Roman enamelled copper alloy vessel, dating to the 2nd century AD. The fragment is slightly curved, indicating it once belonged to a rounded vessel such as a cup or pan (patera). It is decorated on the external surface with cells which would have held enamel. Traces of a fortified turret are visible within a square recess.
